rows.grounds: compound of pañca and ratna in instrumental plural
adjective agreeing with implied neuter object
compound of pañca and mūrdhan in locative
compound of ṣaṣ and ānana, address to the deity

items.question: What adornment distinguishes the five heads of the six-faced deity?
premises: Five jewels variegate the five heads.
The six-faced one is addressed directly.
items.inference: The icon's five heads are distinguished by jeweled variegation.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical case of ṣaḍānana is uncertain.
Whether pañcamūrdhni is singular or plural in sense is unclear.
items.plain_english: Variegated with five jewels on the five heads, O six-faced one.
